beats.label: Hook — The Freeze
beats.voText: What if Earth suddenly stopped spinning?
beats.visual: Earth rotating in starfield, sudden freeze frame at 1.5s, camera push-in
beats.motion: Slow orbit → sudden stop (ease-in-cubic) → dolly push-in

beats.label: Day/Night — Eternal Extremes
beats.voText: One side burns in eternal day. The other freezes in endless night.
beats.visual: Vertical split screen: blinding day side (heat shimmer) / frozen night side (frost crystals)
beats.motion: Split line expands outward, heat shimmer, frost growth, slow push-in

beats.label: Atmosphere — Supersonic Scour
beats.voText: The atmosphere keeps moving. Supersonic winds scour the surface at a thousand miles per hour.
beats.visual: Side-view Earth: teal atmosphere layer rushing, wind arrows, particles ripped up, shockwave cones
beats.motion: High-speed flow lines, particle streaks, shockwave pulses, camera tracks wind

beats.label: Oceans — Polar Surge
beats.voText: Oceans surge toward the poles. Entire continents rise from the drowning depths.
beats.visual: Top-down bathymetry: water rushing poleward (red arrows), equatorial land emerging
beats.motion: Water flow simulation, land rising (scale Y), arrow paths, slow camera orbit

beats.label: Magnetic — Field Collapse
beats.voText: The magnetic field collapses. Cosmic radiation strips the air away, molecule by molecule.
beats.visual: 3D magnetic field lines (gold) flickering/snapping, solar particles penetrating, red sparks
beats.motion: Field line amplitude decay, increasing particle rate, atmosphere fade, slow orbit

beats.label: Temperature — Beyond Survival
beats.voText: Extremes beyond survival. One hundred Celsius day. Minus one hundred Celsius night.
beats.visual: Split thermometers: day mercury → 100°C (cracking), night mercury → -100°C (frost sealing)
beats.motion: Rapid mercury animation, glass crack propagation, frost growth, number counters

beats.label: Life — Extremophiles Endure
beats.voText: Only extremophiles endure. Deep underground. Deep ocean vents. Life... finds a way.
beats.visual: Microscopic: gold archaea at hydrothermal vent (black smoker, teal/gold plumes), camera descends into fissure
beats.motion: Microbe Brownian motion, vent plume turbulence, slow camera descent, bioluminescence pulses

beats.label: Outro — What If Continues
beats.voText: Earth stops. Life persists. What If... continues.
beats.visual: Static Earth in space, slow fade to starfield, channel logo, subscribe button, URL
beats.motion: Earth scale down, logo overshoot, button rise + shimmer, text fade in
